notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.content:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.

Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Manage your crew's actions individually in combat, from manning guns to repairing vehicle components. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.  

Your choices and skills will determine your success, plan wisely and fight fiercely! Wishlist and start your adventure into the lawless Badlands!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/

Dungeons of Hinterberg  

Grab your sword and prepare for an unforgettable adventure in the enchanting alpine village of Hinterberg!  

Join Luisa to conquer the mysterious Dungeons of Hinterberg. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/

Prepare for an exhilarating adventure where innovation meets limitless possibilities. Here, you have the power to transform your most daring RC model construction dreams into tangible reality. Unleash your creativity and push the boundaries of performance.  

Wish list now and embark on this extraordinary journey today and watch as your imagination takes flight! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107090/Kitbash_Model_Club/

A new Dev Blog is out; check all the recent news about Goblin Stone and get ready to fight back! Goblins, orcs, and other monster folk rise against extinction. Wishlist now and join the Goblins in their fight for survival in this roguelike-turned-based RPG. Together, we will triumph! 

Onward, brave souls! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521970/Goblin_Stone/

For The King II  

Inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Prepare to confront Fahrul's once beloved Queen turned tyrant and her army of fearsome Queensguard in the highly anticipated sequel to For The King.  

Whether alone or with a party of four, unravel dark secrets, battle, loot and experience the thrill of this turn-based roguelike RPG.  Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. notes.title: You’ve got to try these Golf Gang workshop courses!
notes.content:
Hey there, Golfers! 

Golf Gang has been in your hands for a couple months now, and in that time, we’ve seen some incredible creations come through the workshop. 

Nice work, everyone! 

Today, we want to feature some of our favourite workshop creations, to show some love and to put them on your radar if you haven’t already checked them out. So let’s start from the top! 

Fall Gang
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/578c34a8d2c30843d7f0270353fb810d348a1268.png

This Fall Guys inspired course is just as vibrant and colourful as the real thing! It’s just as fun too, but with a mini-golf twist. 

Creator: Majesté 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833502554  

Kart Racing Pack 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/e470f110d4b796f6b4ed7a720ed62944dee8a8a6.png

Are you a fan of synthwave? Neon? Colourful city scapes? Well the Kart Racing Pack has you covered. Experience real speed in this awesome race to the finish. 

Creator: Capybarrett 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814307399 

Super Golf Bros. Melee 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/976e0ccf99c9d4cce8a379978f2fd664e146f3c0.jpg

Who doesn’t love Super Smash Bros.? This course is a love letter to one of the best ensemble fighting games of all time! 

Creator: Bap Slambino 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821279396 

Space is the Place 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/83a236dd3853d3479783354d7a48401f6d7a643d.jpg

Space is definitely the place in Golf Gang. Shoot across the stars in this atmospheric course containing a couple creepy surprises. Hint: don’t veer off the beaten path... just trust us. 

Creator: Splashh 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815931388

Accent 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/c82eca986a739281d3f8f70af491221cd111782a.jpg

The jump and energize modifiers are your best friends on this one. Ascend to the finish line, if you can find it... 

Creator: Null 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811664042

 
You can see the full list of workshop courses here. There are plenty to check out and play on with your friends! 

If you want to learn how to make your own courses using the Golf Gang workshop, check out these workshop tutorial videos!

notes.title: 31/05/22 Golf Gang Hotfix

Hey all! 

Today we pushed a hotfix mostly focused on fixing some of the achievements in Golf Gang. Here’s what we specifically addressed: 

Hotfix #3 (31/05/2022) 

 Fixed Master: Sunny Suburbs achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Sunny Suburbs 
 Fixed Master: Winter Golf achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Winter Golf 
 Fixed Master: Sandy Shores achievement to unlock after obtaining overall S score on Sandy Shores 
 Fixed Master: Autumn Breeze achievement unlock after obtaining overall S score on Autumn Breeze

notes.title: Golf Gang’s Week 1 Hotfixes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased and played Golf Gang this week! It’s been great to see you enjoying your time with it. 

We’ve been listening to your feedback and working to address the bugs in Golf Gang. A series of hotfixes have been released since launch, so allow us to outline the changes/improvements for you here: 

Hotfix #1 (23/05/22) 

 Fixed the paddles/rotating environment objects clipping through the ball when it is still/very slow 
 Widened search parameters in lobby browser to allow more lobbies to be visible 
 Fixed the Speed Demon (Get gold on every hole of  in time trials mode) achievements not being awarded 
 Minor UI updates
 
Hotfix #2 (25/05/22) 

 Fixed the propellers moving out of position on Hole 13 of Alpine Resort  
 Fixed a bug where .sav file becomes corrupt, preventing players from entering gameplay 

There are more hotfixes planned for early next week and onward, so we’ll keep you in the loop along the way. Please keep flagging bugs and feedback for us, it’s been extremely helpful so far. 

Also, just a heads up—you can now grab the multiplayer party bundle including Golf Gang and Human: Fall Flat for 44% off on Steam. Two great party games for a fraction of the price! 

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: That's it for now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/489524fdc635835a4a02a79dc6a097d3d731e421.png
Thanks a bunch!

If you liked it, you could wishlist it.

Wishlisting will notify you when the game is released, as well as help us out by giving us an idea of how many prospective golfers there are.

A few interesting stats from a week's worth of festival:


 We had just over 4,000 cool golfers play our game. 
 115 days of Golf Gang were played, with over 150,000 goals, averaging 9 strokes per hole.
 That's (roughly) 1.35 million strokes. 



We are so grateful for you trying our game.

In the meantime, you could hit us up on discord or twitter.
